description: Collected project documentation. Available when get_listing includes readme_api; 404 when no copy was stored. The text lives in R2 (`mural-coleta`). This call does not write and does not fetch GitHub. Same visibility as the listing page. Call it only when the listing page carries `readme_api`: a page without it has no README collected, and this route answers 404.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.

name: get_listing_readme
title: Get listing readme
